summary.label: Synthetic modifications to authentic, previously unseen protocols (5 bases). Not clinical validation.

controls.note: Flags on unmodified protocols are not counted as errors: several come from criterion-specific FDA recommendations (ECOG PS2, Duffy-null ANC). They are reported so differential detection can be interpreted.
